# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and a refreshed HarfBuzzSharp binding surface. Review the HarfBuzzSharp compatibility changes below before moving existing text-shaping code to this preview.

## Breaking Changes

- **HarfBuzz combining-class and flag members updated** — UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is renamed to CCC132, and GlyphFlags.Defined is removed. Update code to use CCC132 and combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 for preview consumers. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 4, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update and regenerated HarfBuzzSharp bindings.
